messages:
evan: Heads-up: we're enabling a docs linter auto-fix mode (soft) and pairing it with a small SDK telemetry tag so we can safely roll out example pinning. Summary below.

rachel: explain 'auto-fix mode' quickly?

evan: auto-fix runs in CI on docs PRs and will open a follow-up commit that adds missing `recommended_pin` + `runtime_weight` to code blocks when it can infer a safe default. Soft mode = creates commits/PR comments only. Hard mode (later) will block merges.

docs-bot: Proof-of-concept script here: ```bash
# runs in docs CI, creates autofix commit
python tools/docs_autofix.py --find-missing-pins --suggest
```

eng-sdk: SDK change: we'll emit a lightweight telemetry tag `docs_autofix_applied=true` on requests created from autofixed examples in our internal runner. No customer-visible data shipped.

pm-bot: Timeline: 2026-04-20 enable autofix (soft); 2026-05-18 SDK patch that adds telemetry tag; 2026-06-01 switch autofix -> suggestion-comments-only (no auto-commits) to give maintainers control; 2026-06-30 hard-lint.

support: Will autofix commits affect customer-facing example text? Might confuse readers if commit messages are noisy.

evan: We'll namespace commits like "docs: autofix/examples add recommended_pin (auto)" and include a clear commit message linking to the migration guide. We'll also add a short banner in PRs explaining why the change was made.

legal: Confirmed: commit metadata and internal telemetry tag are fine. No PII and no contractual change.

docs-bot: We'll add an opt-out front-matter flag `rw_autofix: false` for special cases (internal examples, partner examples). Docs CI will honor it.

rachel: For the SDK telemetry tag, can we keep it off by default in prod SDK builds? want minimal churn.

eng-sdk: Yes. Tagging will only be enabled in the docs/runner build and a small test harness in ci. Production SDK bundles will not send the tag.

support: Need a short KB entry in case customers spot autofix commits and worry about behaviour differences.

evan: Agreed. Support draft: "Why a docs autofix commit appeared" with link to migration guide. Target 2026-04-18.

docs-bot: Autofix ruleset preview uploaded: https://go.redwood/internal/autofix-rules-v1 (internal). It contains heuristics and a safety whitelist.

pm-bot: Action owners: @docs-bot (rules + CI), @eng-sdk (telemetry tag + test harness), @e van (autofix commit msgs + support KB), @legal (final review). Q&A drop-in 2026-04-19 16:00 PT.

rachel: one more ask: add a small audit dashboard so we can see how many autofixes applied per repo/org. Helps prioritize manual reviews.

docs-bot: Will add a dashboard tile in docs analytics. We'll surface top 20 repos with autofix counts.

evan: Thanks all. If no blockers we'll flip soft autofix on 2026-04-20. Reply here if you need to be looped in. :sparkles:
